caveat: Adaptive retrospective follow-up after inspecting the four raw-shot challengers. The same four fixed model recipes are re-evaluated with a consistent league-summary xG definition and recent coverage. These seasons are not an untouched holdout; future prospective validation is required.
source: Raw Understat league-summary CSVs via elliot-gautier-129/footy-prediction at 90233c5edc2cd4a07011ea642b27ea479d106bf5; extend using only raw xG facts from CameronNichol47/epl-match-prediction-dashboard at 647420c6bb756db992374b04a5ba0ee6235a2624. No application features or models imported.
sourcePolicy: Pin all source Git blobs and SHA-256s. Match exact date, canonical teams and actual score to original data. Require overlap league-summary xG agreement within 1e-4; primary summary source wins. Exclude raw-shot-sum archive and Football-Data xG. Missing xG uses actual-goal targets, without dropping a fixture.
dataFence: Fit only matches whose date is strictly before target date minus one calendar day. Weighted goals/xG conversion is also past-only. Observed target-match xG and results never enter its prediction.
target: goalWeight * actualGoals + (1 - goalWeight) * expectedGoals * pastWeightedGoalsPerXg; same nonnegative quasi-Poisson likelihood and team shrinkage as the reference
selectionRule: On identical 736 reference-eligible validation fixtures, select minimum log loss among variants improving reference log loss without reducing top-outcome accuracy. Save selection before computing its retrospective audit. If none qualifies, retain current candidate.
auditGate: Selected variant must improve Brier and log loss without reducing top-outcome accuracy on identical audit fixtures. Also report day-clustered confidence intervals, season metrics, current-season monitoring, xG coverage and latest xG date. Passing is permission for further prospective evaluation, not default promotion.

sourceInspectionBeforeEvaluation.selectionWindowCoverage: Full three-year xG windows for 2023 and 2024 selection seasons
sourceInspectionBeforeEvaluation.recentCoverage: 80/90 current-season fixtures; last 10 fixtures lack xG and retain actual-goal training targets.
